'''Gaar''' was a title held by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Suppoon]].

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Jabba and his minions have left the Gaar's planet...|Intro of ''Jabba the Hutt: The Hunger of Princess Nampi''|<ref name="Jabba the Hutt: The Hunger of Princess Nampi">''[[Jabba the Hutt: The Hunger of Princess Nampi]]''</ref>}}
The title Gaar first appeared in ''[[Jabba the Hutt: The Gaar Suppoon Hit]]''. It was preceded there and elsewhere with "the" indicating it is a title of some kind.
